title: DELETE /tournaments/:id/rounds/:n response
description: The latest round's pairings removed (with a match-format Swiss, the round before it too): 204 No Content, empty body. Described here as {status, body} because there is no JSON to describe; the provider test records the real status and body. Refusals (error.schema.json): 422 refused unless it is the latest round, or when its games went out in a TRF; 403/404 as for any desk route.

body.description: Nothing: do not parse it as JSON.
